workflows.name: ChatGPT Image -> Flow Veo 3.1 Video Pipeline
workflows.description: Generates a high-detail concept image with ChatGPT, enhances prompt with AI, then animates it into a 4K video using Google Flow Veo 3.1.

data.title: ChatGPT Image 2
data.prompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic shot of a cybernetic samurai standing on a rainy Tokyo rooftop at twilight, neon reflections in puddles, volumetric lighting, 8k octane render

data.title: Google Flow Veo 3.1
data.prompt: Smooth camera dolly forward, slow motion raindrops, glowing katana blade emitting lightning sparks, cinematic atmosphere, 60fps 4k video

promptTemplates.title: Cinematic Anamorphic Film Still
promptTemplates.prompt: Cinematic 35mm film still of {subject}, shot on Arri Alexa with Panavision Anamorphic lenses, golden hour warm lighting, soft atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, 8k raw color grade --ar 16:9

promptTemplates.title: Cyberpunk Neon Rain Cityscape
promptTemplates.prompt: Breathtaking high-angle panoramic view of {subject} in a dense dystopian neo-metropolis, drenched in rain, holographic billboards reflecting on wet asphalt, volumetric god rays piercing heavy fog, Unreal Engine 5 render, cinematic lighting --ar 21:9

promptTemplates.title: National Geographic Wildlife Portrait
promptTemplates.prompt: Extreme macro close-up portrait of {subject}, National Geographic award-winning photography, shot on Sony A1 with 85mm f/1.4 GM lens, crisp eye reflections, intricate fur and skin textures, natural daylight, bokeh background --ar 4:5

promptTemplates.title: Studio Ghibli Lush Anime Landscape
promptTemplates.prompt: Hand-painted anime background in the style of Studio Ghibli, featuring {subject}, vibrant emerald rolling meadows, fluffy cumulus clouds in a cerulean sky, soft afternoon sunlight, watercolor aesthetic, whimsical nostalgic atmosphere --ar 16:9

promptTemplates.title: Dark Fantasy Eldritch Knight

promptTemplates.title: Luxury Architectural Interior Villa

promptTemplates.title: Commercial Product Studio Shot
promptTemplates.prompt: High-end commercial studio product photography of {subject}, placed on polished black obsidian pedestal with gentle water ripples, dramatic dual studio softbox rim lighting, floating botanical ingredients, crisp focus, Hasselblad H6D-100c --ar 1:1

promptTemplates.title: 3D Octane Claymation Character
